neighbours.label: the word right after a degree adverb like 'rather' (rather more, rather too, rather as) or 'очень' ('очень и очень'); 'would rather' stays quiet
fire: The talks were held in rather more humble rooms this year.
I found the plot stretched rather too thinly in places.
The painter shows her rather as a tired queen.
Вопрос этот очень и очень сложный.
Prices have risen rather more than we expected.
The sequel leans rather too heavily on old jokes.
He treats his staff rather as family.
Погода в этом году очень и очень странная.
quiet: The talks were held in humble rooms this year.
I found the plot thin in places.
The painter shows her as a tired queen.
Prices have risen as we expected.
The sequel leans heavily on old jokes.
He would rather go home and rest.

short: word after 'rather': rather more, rather too
